info.title: Finance Backend API
info.description: RESTful API backend for dual-version finance management application supporting Admin and User versions of Flutter mobile app

get.description: Returns total counts of users, expenses, transfers, incoming transactions, and fund box balance
Returns a list of all users with their transaction counts and last activity timestamps
Returns expense totals by currency and by user with optional date range filtering
Returns aggregated analytics data for a specified date range including expenses, transfers, and incoming transactions
Returns the authenticated admin's group information including group code

404.description: Admin does not have a group

message.example: Admin does not have a group.

post.description: Generates a new unique group code for the authenticated admin

404.description: Admin does not have a group

get.description: Returns paginated list of users in the authenticated admin's group

404.description: Admin does not have a group

delete.description: Removes a user from the authenticated admin's group

404.description: User not found or not in group

message.example: Failed to remove member from group.

post.description: Allows a regular user to join an admin's group using a group code

403.description: Cannot join group (organization mismatch or already in group)

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's group information

404.description: User is not in a group

message.example: User is not in a group.

get.description: Returns paginated audit logs with filtering by user, action, resource type, and date range
Returns a single audit log entry with user information

post.description: Creates a new user account with hashed password and returns authentication token. Admin users automatically get a group created with a unique group code. Regular users can optionally join a group using a group code during registration.

role.description: User role: 'admin' for group managers, 'user' for regular users

group_code.description: Optional group code to join an admin's group (4-6 digit numeric code). Only for regular users. Organization name must match admin's organization.

admin_group_id.description: ID of the admin group this user belongs to (null if not in a group)

group.description: Group information (only present for admin users or users who joined with group code)

message.example: The email has already been taken.

items.example: The email has already been taken.
Invalid group code or organization mismatch.

message.example: Cannot join group from different organization.

post.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns a Sanctum token valid for 30 days
Revokes the current user's authentication token
Issues a new authentication token for the current user
Generates a secure reset token and sends it via email

message.example: Password reset link sent to your email.
Failed to send password reset link.

post.description: Updates user password with token validation

get.description: Returns the currently authenticated user's information
Get paginated list of expenses. Regular users see only their expenses, admins see all.

post.description: Creates a new expense record with multi-currency support and optional photo/invoice attachment

get.description: Returns a single expense record. Users can only view their own expenses, admins can view all.

post.description: Updates an existing expense record with optional photo. Users can only update their own expenses, admins can update all. Note: Use POST with _method=PUT for file uploads.

delete.description: Soft deletes an expense record and removes associated invoice files. Users can only delete their own expenses, admins can delete all.

get.description: Downloads the invoice file for an expense. Users can only download invoices for their own expenses, admins can download all.

post.description: Uploads an invoice file for an expense. Images are compressed to max 1920px width. Max file size 10MB.

delete.description: Deletes the invoice file for an expense. Users can only delete invoices for their own expenses, admins can delete all.

post.description: Generates a formatted PDF document with expense records and returns a download URL valid for 24 hours
Generates an XLSX file with expense records in tabular format and returns a download URL valid for 24 hours
Generates an export including data from all users with user identification columns

get.description: Downloads a generated export file. Files are valid for 24 hours after generation.
Returns the current status of an export job
Returns a paginated list of user's exports. Admins can see all exports with ?all=true parameter.

post.description: Uploads a file with validation (type, size limits). Images are compressed to max 1920px width.

file.description: File to upload (JPEG, PNG, PDF, max 10MB)

get.description: Downloads a file using an encrypted path parameter for secure access

delete.description: Deletes a file using an encrypted path parameter

get.description: Returns the current fund box balance and last calculated timestamp. Admins see their group's fund box, regular users see their own.

put.description: Updates the fund box balance with validation for non-negative values. Admins update their group's fund box, regular users update their own.

get.description: Get paginated list of incoming transactions. Regular users see only their records, admins see all.

post.description: Creates a new incoming funds transaction record

get.description: Returns a single incoming funds transaction. Users can only view their own records, admins can view all.

put.description: Updates an existing incoming funds transaction. Users can only update their own records, admins can update all.

delete.description: Soft deletes an incoming funds transaction. Users can only delete their own records, admins can delete all.

post.description: Process multiple create, update, or delete operations in a single request with individual success/failure tracking

get.description: Returns all records modified after a specific timestamp for synchronization

post.description: Resolves data synchronization conflicts using specified strategy (server_wins, client_wins, merge, newest_wins)

get.description: Get paginated list of transfers with optional exchange data. Regular users see only their transfers, admins see all.

post.description: Creates a new transfer record with optional currency exchange information

get.description: Returns a single transfer record with exchange data. Users can only view their own transfers, admins can view all.

put.description: Updates an existing transfer record. Users can only update their own transfers, admins can update all.

delete.description: Soft deletes a transfer record. Users can only delete their own transfers, admins can delete all.

post.description: Links currency exchange data to a transfer record with exchange rate snapshots

422.description: Validation error or exchange already exists

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile information including name, email, role, and account dates

put.description: Updates the authenticated user's profile information (name, email)

delete.description: Soft deletes the authenticated user's account and all associated records

put.description: Changes the authenticated user's password with current password verification

422.description: Validation error or incorrect current password
